$comment: Projection of the pinned VMware Cloud Foundation 9.0.0.0 vSphere Automation API specification for vCenter. Provenance is recorded in docs/official_sources.json. This file is protected; it is the authority for every request the acceptance harness inspects, and the loopback fixture serves nothing outside it.
basePathNote: The pinned specification declares servers[0].url as 'https://{host}/api', so every path below is reached at '/api' + path.

basic_auth.note: Declared by the specification. Cis.Session_create is the only operation in scope that uses it.

api_key_auth.name: vmware-api-session-id
api_key_auth.note: Declared by the specification. Every other operation in scope uses it, carrying the session token returned by Cis.Session_create.

Cis.Session_create.summary: Creates a session with the API. This is the equivalent of login.
Cis.Session_create.requestBodyNote: The pinned specification declares no requestBody for this operation. Credentials travel in the HTTP Basic Authorization header, and the request is sent with no body.

201.description: Newly created session token to be used for authenticating further requests.
201.encoding: bare JSON string; the entire body is one JSON-encoded string, not an object

401.description: if the session creation fails due to request specific issues

503.description: if session creation fails due to server specific issues

Content.Library_find.summary: Returns a list of all the visible libraries matching the requested Content.Library.FindSpec.

requestBody.description: Specification describing what properties to filter on.

200.description: The list of identifiers of all the visible libraries matching the given spec.

400.description: if no properties are specified in the spec.

Content.Library.Item_find.summary: Returns identifiers of all the visible library items matching the requested Content.Library.Item.FindSpec.

requestBody.description: Specification describing what properties to filter on.

200.description: The list of identifiers of all the visible library items matching the given spec.

400.description: if no properties are specified in the spec.

parameters.name: Client-Token
parameters.description: A unique token generated on the client for each creation request. The token should be a universally unique identifier (UUID), for example: b8a2a2e3-2314-43cd-a871-6ede0f429751. This token can be used to guarantee idempotent creation. If not specified creation is not idempotent.

requestBody.description: Specification that defines the properties of the new library item.

201.description: Identifier of the new library item.
201.encoding: bare JSON string; the entire body is one JSON-encoded string, not an object

400.description: Vapi.Std.Errors.InvalidArgument if name is empty, name exceeds 80 characters, description exceeds 2000 characters, or the clientToken does not conform to the UUID format. Vapi.Std.Errors.AlreadyExists if there is already a library item with same name in the library.

404.description: if the library_id property of createSpec refers to a library that does not exist.

Content.Library.Item_get.summary: Returns the Content.Library.ItemModel with the given identifier.

200.description: The Content.Library.ItemModel instance with the given libraryItemId.

404.description: if no item with the given libraryItemId exists.

name.description: Name of the library to search. The name is case-insensitive. If not specified any name will be searched.

type.description: Library type to search. If not specified any library type will be searched.

storage_backing.description: Library StorageBacking to search. Added in vSphere API 9.0.0.0. If not specified any storage backing will be searched.

Content.Library.FindSpec.description: Specifies the properties that can be used as a filter to find libraries. When multiple properties are specified, all properties of the library must match the specification.

name.description: The name of the library item. The name is case-insensitive. If not specified all library item names are searched.

library_id.description: The identifier of the library containing the item. If not specified all libraries are searched.

source_id.description: The identifier of the library item as reported by the publisher. If not specified all library items are searched.

type.description: The type of the library item. The type is case-insensitive. If not specified all types are searched.

cached.description: Whether the item is cached. If not specified all library items are searched.

Content.Library.Item.FindSpec.description: Specifies the properties that can be used as a filter to find library items. When multiple properties are specified, all properties of the item must match the specification.

id.usage: not used for create; not present in get or list responses; not used for update

library_id.usage: must be provided for create; always present in get or list responses; not used for update

name.usage: must be provided for create; always present in get or list responses; optional for update
name.description: The name may not be missing or null or an empty string. The name does not have to be unique, even within the same library.

description.usage: optional for create; always present in get or list responses; optional for update
description.description: Leaving it missing or null during creation will result in an empty string value.

type.description: An optional type identifier which indicates the type adapter plugin to use. During creation, if the type is left unspecified the library item is considered generic.

content_version.usage: not used for create; always present in get or list responses

creation_time.usage: not used for create; always present in get or list responses

last_modified_time.usage: not used for create; always present in get or list responses

last_sync_time.usage: not used for create; optional in get or list responses; missing or null for an item in a local library

metadata_version.usage: not used for create; always present in get or list responses

cached.usage: not used for create; always present in get or list responses

size.usage: not used for create; optional in get or list responses

version.usage: not used for create; always present in get or list responses; optional for update

source_id.usage: not used for create; optional in get or list responses; missing or null for an item in a local library

security_compliance.usage: not used for create or update; present in get or list responses. Added in vSphere API 7.0.3.0

certificate_verification_info.usage: not used for create or update; may be present in get or list responses. Added in vSphere API 7.0.3.0

Content.Library.ItemModel.description: Represents a library item that has been stored in a library.

Content.Library.StorageBacking.description: The specification for backing a library with a storage location.

messages.description: Stack of one or more localizable messages for human error consumers.

data.description: Data to facilitate clients responding to the operation reporting a standard error.

error_type.description: Discriminator field to help API consumers identify the structure type. Added in vSphere API 6.7.2.

Vapi.Std.Errors.Error.description: Describes the properties common to all standard errors.

id.description: Unique identifier of the localizable string or message template.

default_message.description: The value of this localizable string or message template in the en_US locale.

args.description: Positional arguments to be substituted into the message template.

Vapi.Std.LocalizableMessage.description: Represents a localizable string or message template.

wireRules.omitUnsetOptionalFields: An optional property that has no value MUST be absent from the request body. Never send it as null, as an empty string, as an empty array, or as an empty object. The Initialize-ContentLibrary* model initializers keep every unset member on the object and their ToJson() renders those members as null, so the null members have to be stripped before the body goes on the wire.
wireRules.memberNaming: Request body member names are the snake_case names in this contract, for example library_id. The PowerShell property names on the SDK model objects are PascalCase and are not wire names.
wireRules.sessionToken: Cis.Session_create is called once with an HTTP Basic Authorization header and no body, and returns the session token as a bare JSON string. Every other operation carries that token in the vmware-api-session-id header and sends no Authorization header.
wireRules.clientTokenIdempotency: Content.Library.Item_create accepts a Client-Token request header holding a UUID. vCenter records the token against the item it creates, so a create replayed with the same Client-Token returns the identifier of the item that already exists instead of creating a second one. A retry that mints a fresh token is a different creation request and is rejected with 400 Vapi.Std.Errors.AlreadyExists once the first attempt has committed. One token per library item, generated before the first attempt and reused unchanged for every retry of that item.
wireRules.clientTokenScope: The Client-Token header belongs to Content.Library.Item_create only. It is not sent on any other operation.
wireRules.unknownMembers: vCenter rejects a request body carrying a member that is not declared by its schema with 400 Vapi.Std.Errors.UnexpectedInput.
